basis.source: Кодекс архитектуры: meanings, actions, state, storage, data acquisition, composition, restoration; project instructions preserve pure geometry/camera and server separation.
basis.purpose: Compare the existing foundation with a proposed target and expose deviations; do not manufacture green exceptions.

groupingNotes: Existing feature action code has no dedicated action module yet. It remains assigned to its current file owner; prohibited data dependencies expose this migration work. No empty implemented action/auth/journal module is invented.
Pure camera and physical chart input are different modules because DOM/gesture dependencies would invalidate the camera boundary.
Reusable calendar/timeline input files are assigned by responsibility, even though they currently live in views/.
Output escaping/text projection is one explicit presentation-primitives module; permitting it does not expose calendar/popup mechanics to renderers.
CSS/HTML are acknowledged assets; this import checker does not claim to validate their styles, selectors or inline behavior.
File SCC checks include type imports even inside one semantic owner; current ownership does not hide future renderer cycles.
Exact named type contracts pass values only. ChartStore, MandalaMode and other mutable controllers are deliberately not whitelisted.
The ordinary birth-form owner includes its accepted random-chart generator; broad feature access to transport remains forbidden.

modules.responsibility: Connect browser owners and transfer the early startup instances to the running application.
Environment-independent definitions and checked formats crossing browser/server calculation boundaries.
Pure meanings and rules of charts, moments, cycles, topology, time and astronomical projections.
Selected record, requested moment, accepted result and chart-tool commands; no presentation ownership.
Collect and restore state through owner ports; supersede pending restoration on a newer explicit command.
notes: Camera is permitted as a type-owned port because that pure owner defines view transforms. Concrete mandala UI/controller types are not allowed; use an explicit restoration port.

modules.responsibility: Tab-level open sides and central screen, independent of chart-tool commands and page geometry.

Own persistence, validated stored records, confirmed snapshots and agreed result-cache adapters. Coordinate device-quota relief through supplied owner ports; never access journal internals or choose visible state.

privateEntryReasons.src/data/indexed-db.ts: Raw database connection stays behind storage adapters.
privateEntryReasons.src/data/calculation-migration.ts: Legacy source reading, version fencing and deletion are internal to the single calculation-cache budget owner.
One-time schema-upgrade conversion owned by account-library storage; no old writer runs alongside the upgrade.

modules.responsibility: Acquire and validate requested data, share in-flight work and cancel independent waiters.
Selection values, model, state and transient hover projection; no storage or feature-screen ownership.
Pure drawing shapes, anchors, bounds and geometry descriptors; no UI, scene execution, state or content catalogue.
notes: Each explicit geometry entry exposes pure shape/anchor values; integration-geometry exposes STEM_POINTS and INTEGRATION_ARMS, not mutable renderer internals.

modules.responsibility: Pure camera transform, fit and movement boundaries; receives measurements and does not measure DOM.
Translate pointer/DOM gesture coordinates into camera and selection commands; keep physical input outside pure camera.
Mandala view switching and its visual transition; state persistence is coordinated elsewhere.
Project accepted chart/selection values to drawing output; rendering internals are not general view contracts.
Generate the initial drawing HTML before browser execution; not a browser module entry.
Reusable input, calendar, timeline gesture, popup text and page-level gesture mechanics; no feature persistence.
Semantic drawing palettes; CSS/HTML are separate static assets outside this TS import scope.
Measure shell and place panels/headings/timeline using its own size contracts; never depend on scene/state/views.
Pure availability/visibility and timeline mark rules from passed values; no controller-owned types.
Authored explanatory content and names, separately from technical messages and drawing geometry.
Display feature state and emit user intentions; mutating storage and obtaining results belong to actions/clients.
notes: No import of a data-storage owner is allowed, including its concrete type. Views should receive narrowly typed read models and action ports, not a writable store.
No direct client import: request/calculation orchestration is extracted to action owners. This is a proposed technical target, not a claim that current forms already comply.

modules.responsibility: Frame measurement only; not the future persistent application journal.
Shared palette controls restore the user-selected drawing style before local and production startup.
Separate story page composition with the same drawing/domain facilities.
Connect configured services, one compute queue and the HTTP listener.
Transport validation, request lifetime and response/static-file delivery; feature policy belongs to services.
Calculation/service policy, prepared data, request coalescing and agreed caches, independent of HTTP objects.
One cancellation and consumer-lifetime rule for unfinished shared jobs. Does not launch processes, own an admission queue or retain completed results.
Physical process/queue/consumer lifecycle and file signatures; the specialized calculator IPC adapter may know its explicitly declared request wire type, while calculation rules remain in services.
Encode and compress calculation packet formats; shared contracts define wire values.
Shared output escaping and economical text projection; no feature actions, state or popup lifecycle.
Действия входа и права; правила попыток и ограничений. Не расчётный сервис и не HTTP.
Основная база: физическое соединение/транзакция и операции записей. Отдельно от расчётных кэшей.

privateEntryReasons.server/storage/calculation-transition.ts: One-time atomic schema transition preserving prepared values; invoked only by the coordinated storage cutover.

modules.responsibility: Только нынешние чистые сроки и пределы письма. Очереди/отправителя здесь ещё нет.
Client account lifecycle and login action: input, pending/accepted state, restoration, logout coordination and current replies. Server access authority remains separate.
Точные слова для известной причины; без DOM, запросов, прав, хранения и повторов.
Delivery command and cancellation port shared by account and mail owners; no account policy or storage.
Encode the accepted email using a standard MIME library; delivering and retaining messages are separate responsibilities.
Own accepted queue limits, reconciliation, cancellation and permitted delivery attempts; storage and physical Postfix remain separate.
notes: PostfixQueue is an explicitly declared command port with list/submit/remove/send/close, not a value-only contract or inferred ReturnType. Runtime construction of transport belongs to composition.

modules.responsibility: Contact only configured local SMTP and private Unix control socket; validate transport results. No account decisions, retry policy or database ownership.
Account chart mutations and owned/public reads; one transaction guards access, duplicate identity, note revision and compact 48-hour outcome. Receives prepared calculations, not raw HTTP input.
Prepare full persistent chart data from source input through the existing city and calculation owners; validate complete server output before storage.
Prepare explicit platform configuration for the reviewed local mail instance from the one accepted mail policy. No installation or service startup.
Own the accepted journal retention and total budget, and pure bounded bookkeeping helpers. No IO or product state.
Define and validate exact permitted diagnostic facts; no raw requests, mail bodies, secrets or business mutations.
Single server reporting facade: bound and validate facts, isolate reporting failures. No queue, persistence, business state or delivery ownership.
Persist bounded JSONL facts, recover the derived index, acknowledge durable acceptance and discard records within the one policy. Receives facts, never owns account/card outcomes.
Own the loaded private library and its account generation; accept current reads into the persistent lease without choosing the visible chart.
Own explicit chart write intents, one submission and read-only outcome recovery; guest calculation remains a temporary chart.
Verify the official provider signature and claims against a trusted key set and a specific attempt. Does not create accounts, persist tokens or grant sessions.
Own the current browser route and history changes; page loading, access and view restoration remain with their respective owners.
Fetch the bounded official Telegram key set for an active attempt and delegate cryptographic claims to its verifier; no account grants or persistent key archive.
Independent optional diagnostic subsystem. Exposes one browser facade; owns report format, attribution, queue, bounded delivery and cleanup, never product behavior or presentation.

privateEntryReasons.src/diagnostics/browser-source.ts: Journal-owned browser error subscriptions and coarse environment fields; no raw error or user agent persistence.
privateEntryReasons.src/diagnostics/client-reports.ts: Journal implementation: product owners report through src/journal.ts; queue, format and delivery stay private.
privateEntryReasons.src/data/diagnostic-queue.ts: Journal implementation: product owners report through src/journal.ts; queue, format and delivery stay private.
privateEntryReasons.src/data/diagnostic-client.ts: Journal implementation: product owners report through src/journal.ts; queue, format and delivery stay private.
privateEntryReasons.src/data/diagnostic-delivery.ts: Journal implementation: product owners report through src/journal.ts; queue, format and delivery stay private.

modules.responsibility: Own the complete public application CacheStorage bundle, integrity checks and safe retirement; never store API or personal data.
Connect the browser service-worker lifecycle to the bundle owner; activation and retirement require explicit coordinator approval.
Coordinate durable tab preparation and restoration with service workers; keep actual loaded release identity separate from worker status.
Local development inbox transport to fixed loopback Mailpit; source-stand opt-in, socket/Host/Origin boundary and credential isolation. Owns no accounts or mail queue.
Share only the lifetime of in-flight work and independent consumer cancellation; no transport, storage or retained results.
Coordinate application lifecycle and route intent through narrow ports; no DOM, browser storage or copied chart data.

privateEntryReasons.src/application/account-boundary.ts: Account transitions and safe cleanup retry are scoped to the application lifetime.

cyclePolicy.reason: File cycles remain visible even within a semantic module.

exactExceptions.reason: Подготовка настоящего загрузочного HTML до выполнения браузерного приложения; один генератор используется серверной выдачей и выпускной сборкой. Не делает генератор публичным браузерным входом.
Geometry reads immutable named topology from the exact catalogue file. No general access to authored reference modules, effects or state is granted. This exception checks files, not exported names.
The isolated journal storage adapter uses the common IndexedDB connection mechanism; this does not expose diagnostic records or grant product code direct queue access.

assets.reason: Explicit manifest of allowed prepared-data revision transitions; separate from importable code.

packages.reason: The approved MIME adapter uses Nodemailer without a framework; no browser or other file receives this permission.
The local SMTP adapter uses the approved library; this grants no package access to the account policy, queue or browser.
The isolated Telegram OIDC verifier uses a standard signature/JWT implementation. No account policy, browser, arbitrary remote-key URL or framework receives this permission.
The mail-only packaging CLI uses the existing development bundler to prepare deployment artifacts; this permission does not extend to application runtime or other files.
Pinned v5 interprets the approved state machine; platform and data access remain behind ports.
Pure application transition table and cancellable child operation in the approved v5 runtime.
Account boundary actor uses the same pinned application runtime.

modules.responsibility: Astronomy, civil time, date bounds and calculation errors.
Prepared movement index and index query contract.
Executable JSON/CLI calculation scenarios, not module APIs to other layers.
Privileged local Postfix control and expiry cleanup. Queue policy and application state remain in their respective owners; Unix-socket commands are a separate runtime boundary.
Native local Postfix outcome adapter into the existing mail queue: checked terminal facts only, no second body store or raw mail log.
Validated privileged installation of the one local Postfix instance and its service helpers. Does not own account or mail-queue policy.
One-time legacy transit cache removal anchored to no-follow directory descriptors. Accepts only server configuration; never calculates or owns application storage policy.
Explicit per-user macOS development receiver setup with verified Mailpit binary and private temporary inbox. No production deployment, DNS or application policy.

Explicit offline Linux storage layout preparation: separate existing state, journal and cache zones, preserve prepared data across release replacement. Does not generate calculations, own retention or start services.

limits: Import policy verifies static dependencies and file ownership only; injected writable ports/effects/callbacks require semantic or behavioral checks.
A passed file/module graph does not prove independent lifecycles or product safety.
Types follow semantic ownership; rendering/controller implementation types are not general domain contracts.
This policy is a proposed technical declaration. It does not change approved UI text, product behavior, cache or storage policy.

stableValueContracts.reason: Специализированный IPC-адаптер калькулятора знает форму передаваемого запроса. Предметные правила и расчётные решения остаются в сервисах; это не разрешение импортировать исполняемые функции.
Три представления одного HTTP-тела: identity, br и gzip. Это договор байтов для доставки, без зависимости от алгоритма расчётного пакета.
Снимок сохраняет значения x/y/k/maxK, определённые владельцем камеры. Тип изменяемого контроллера Camera и функции камеры этим договором не разрешаются.
Компоновка получает описание рамки рисунка как значение. Импорт геометрических расчётов, контроллеров сцены или состояния не разрешается.
Идентификатор предмета для поиска статьи, без модели выбора/изменения состояния.
Значение outline/glow; не вычисления геометрии и не контроллер рисунка.
Переданное значение состояния связи, без fetch/подписки/переключения симуляции.
Используется только SavedView[charts] для входного снимка и возвращаемого значения. Не разрешает ViewStore или исполняемые функции.
Описание причины/статуса/вариантов ответа, без запуска запроса. Допустимо только import type указанного имени; не даёт requestJSON.
Используется только SavedView[knowledge], значение для восстановления и снимка.
Используется только SavedView[knowledge], значение для восстановления и снимка.
Only local control socket and SMTP port configuration values; no PostfixQueue controller or transport functions are allowed by this grant.
Форма переданных сроков и пределов очереди. Хранилище принимает значения от владельца почтовой политики; импорт отправки, очереди и исполняемых функций не разрешается.
